packageRules.description: Group every third-party dependency (npm via pnpm, the caddy-desec Dockerfile, and the regex-managed container/version pins) into a single non-major PR to minimize CI runs on this metered-free public repo.
Group major updates separately so a single breaking major cannot block routine patch/minor bumps.

customManagers.description: Container image constants in src/system/matrix.ts (Synapse, Caddy, onboarding-api Node base image). Deliberately excludes DEFAULT_CADDY_DESEC_IMAGE, which is a first-party image built from deploy/caddy-desec/Dockerfile and published to this org's own GHCR namespace.
Hardcoded postgres image literal in the Synapse docker-compose template string in src/system/matrix.ts (no named constant exists for it).
frp tunnel client image pin in src/installer/real-service-shared.ts, used for the relay tunnel default image.

OpenClaw CLI version pin in src/openclaw/bootstrap.ts. Uses the npm datasource (package `openclaw`) rather than github-releases: the npm registry carries all 248 published versions in the exact unprefixed CalVer-ish format used by the pin (e.g. "2026.3.13"), while GitHub Releases for openclaw/openclaw only exist for a handful of recent, mostly-beta, v-prefixed tags (e.g. "v2026.9.1-beta.1") that would need prefix stripping and cover far less history.
